sourceTitle: Wampum A Paper Presented to the Numismatic and Antiquarian Society of Philadelphia
description: "Wampum" by Ashbel Woodward is a scholarly essay that offers a detailed exploration into the historical significance and cultural relevance of wampum, a traditional form of shell bead currency used by Native American tribes. Written in the late 19th century, specifically 1878, the text stems from a presentation made to the Numismatic and Antiquarian Society of Philadelphia in 1868.
